asins.title: ASINs
asins.description: Amazon ASINs (10 chars) or product URLs. A product URL (e.g. https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0...) is scraped on its own marketplace, so one run can mix marketplaces; bare ASINs use the Marketplace field below.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain suffix (amazon.<marketplace>) for bare ASINs. Product URLs keep their own domain.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel browser-like sessions (each with its own IP and cookies). Automatically capped to what the run memory supports (~1 session per 12 MB: 512 MB → 42, 1 GB → 50). The actor backs off on its own if Amazon starts blocking.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Default: Apify datacenter proxy, automatically escalating to residential for ASINs that get blocked. Pick a proxy group to force it for every request.

debugHtml.title: Save HTML (debug)
debugHtml.description: Store fetched pages in the key-value store for troubleshooting.
